For other uses, see Mifune (disambiguation).

Mifune is a character introduced in Brave Frontier I as a unit. In Brave Frontier II, Mifune appears as an NPC.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: In Brave Frontier I, Mifune can be fought and captured as a unit throughout various regions in Grand Gaia.
